description: This file defines the Goteo Controller for managing banners in the admin interface, including actions for listing, editing, adding, activating, moving, removing, translating, and processing banners.

classes.name: Goteo\Controller\Admin\BannersSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing banners in the admin interface, providing methods for CRUD operations, ordering, activation, and translation of banners.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access this controller based on node and role.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles the translation action for a banner, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing a banner, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new banner, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a banner up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a banner down in order.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to handle different banner actions such as add, edit, remove, activate, move up/down, translate, with form processing and redirects.
